item.title: Backend
item.description:
Backend link

Backend is a REST-server built with nodejs and expressjs.

You need Docker to run backend.

Note!! Install database before starting backend for the first time As database the backend uses PostgreSQL (https://www.postgresql.org/). The docker from project repository uses TimescaleDB that is a PostgreSQL extension. You can use any kind of PostgreSQL installation you have access to (docker/local install/remote server).

item.title: Installation
item.description:
1. Install PostgreSQL

  2. Install Docker

  3. Create PostgreSQL role with password for backend (in example code username “biogas”)

  4. Create database (in example code “digibiogashub”)

    sudo -i -u postgres
createuser --interactive
Enter name of role to add: biogas
Shall the new role be a superuser? (y/n) n
Shall the new role be allowed to create databases? (y/n) n
Shall the new role be allowed to create more new roles? (y/n) n
psql
\password biogas
Enter new password for user "biogas":
Enter it again:
CREATE DATABASE "digibiogashub" OWNER biogas;

  5. Clone the repository
